from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys

inputs = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = json.loads(inputs.read_text())
for name, wanted in expected.items():
    data = Path(name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == wanted, name
    if name.endswith('.md'):
        assert data.endswith(b'\n') and not re.search(rb'[ \t]+$', data, re.M), name

review_bindings = {
    'research/astra-adapted-grid-uniform-review.md': 'research/astra-adapted-grid-uniform-audit.md',
    'research/astra-forward-grid-insertion-review.md': 'research/astra-forward-grid-insertion.md',
}
for review, author in review_bindings.items():
    assert expected[author] in Path(review).read_text(), review

r = json.loads(Path('research/astra-forward-grid-control.json').read_text())
for item in r['frozen_execution'].values():
    assert hashlib.sha256(item['source'].encode()).hexdigest() == item['sha256']
program = r['frozen_execution']['program']
assert program['exit_status'] == 0 and program['stderr'] == ''
assert len(program['stdout'].encode()) == program['stdout_bytes']
assert program['stderr_bytes'] == 0
output = json.loads(program['stdout'])
assert output['program_source_sha256'] == program['sha256']
assert output['boxes'] == r['result']['boxes']
assert r['result']['status'] == 'bounded_nonfinding'
for box, count in [('N5', 1140), ('N6', 1820)]:
    b = output['boxes'][box]
    assert b['scanned_tuple_count'] == b['expected_tuple_count'] == count
    assert b['aggregate_before_stop']['tuples_with_forward_good_residue'] == count
    assert b['completed_entire_box'] and b['failure'] is None
for path, wanted in r['settled_contract'].items():
    assert expected[path] == wanted
assert r['delivery_metrics']['worker_elapsed_seconds'] is None
assert r['delivery_metrics']['first_check_success'] is True
assert r['delivery_metrics']['worker_repair_rounds'] == 0
assert r['delivery_metrics']['astra_repair_rounds'] == 1
assert not r['packaging_history']['mathematical_program_rerun_after_first_success']

checks = []
for argv in [
    ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'],
    ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
    ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py'],
]:
    done = subprocess.run(argv, text=True, capture_output=True)
    checks.append(dict(argv=argv, exit_code=done.returncode, stdout=done.stdout, stderr=done.stderr))
    assert done.returncode == 0, checks[-1]

record = dict(
    checkpoint='Pass67',
    parent_main='600287d55a01d3c8c2d3bf4e4114eee4f9c1271e',
    status='Reviewed adapted-grid manuscripts and one exact bounded forward control; unrestricted canonical goal unresolved.',
    hashes=expected,
    root_verifier=dict(argv=sys.argv, source_utf8=Path(__file__).read_text(), input_utf8=inputs.read_text()),
    checks=checks,
    mathematical_verification='Source-bound independent Astra reviews and root full reads. Root inspected the actual frozen Terra executable and packer; verified bindings and retained output without replaying the screen. The integer phase construction matches the reviewed contract. Fraction inequalities share its modular residue calculation and do not constitute a separate phase implementation.',
    bounded_control='All1140 increasing triples1..20 atN5 and1820 quadruples1..16 atN6 have a forward-good residue. No failure branch, appended-grid construction or full-witness search ran; no domain expansion.',
    evidence_limits='The executable first run succeeded. One patch-transport packaging retry and one root metadata clarification are retained separately. No uniform grid supply, no new Lean declaration and no LRC proof or disproof.',
    storage='No local Lean cache restored. Storage report retained among checks.',
)
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed', frozen_files=len(expected), checks=checks, receipt=sys.argv[2]), sort_keys=True))
